src/Models/Task.php:
<?php

namespace App\Models;

class Task {
    private string $judul;
    private string $deskripsi;
    private bool $selesai = false;

    public function __construct(string $judul, string $deskripsi) {
        $this->judul = $judul;
        $this->deskripsi = $deskripsi;
    }

    public function complete(): void {
        $this->selesai = true;
    }

    public function getJudul(): string {
        return $this->judul;
    }

    public function isSelesai(): bool {
        return $this->selesai;
    }
}
src/Services/Logger.php:
<?php

namespace App\Services;

class Logger {
    public static function info(string $pesan): void {
        echo "[INFO] " . date("Y-m-d H:i:s") . " - " . $pesan . "\n";
    }
}
